support_polygon_lab.name: What Lets a Body Stand?
support_polygon_lab.description: Selectable finite support patches and an editable centre of mass; release a real rigid load under gravity, then compare a static support forecast with its measured tilt.
interactions: FEET selects four, three, adjacent pair or diagonal pair of support pads
SHIFT selects a custom centre of mass before release
RELEASE enables rigid-body gravity and collisions
PARTS reveals support hull, mass projection and tilt
RESET returns the load to its held beginning
support_polygon_lab.qfep_connection: Makes the assumptions of static support visible; a prescribed walking diagram is not evidence of dynamic balance.
